findings.problem: For 'real' with the hint 'as in the real reason', a fluent speaker would just as likely say eigentlich (der eigentliche Grund) or wahr (der wahre Grund), and echt or tatsächlich also fit 'real' or 'actual', so the hint does not rule out these other common answers.
findings.fix: hint: actual, existing in fact, as in real life; not echt, wahr, eigentlich or tatsächlich

note: The example is correct, but der eigentliche Grund or der wahre Grund is the more usual way to say it, so an example like "Das ist das wirkliche Leben." would teach the word better. The trick is apt, because wirklich really does come from wirken (to work, to have an effect).
